concepts.title: Circuit Fork
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished distinct logo concept for ForkLogic, a recipe organizer, meal planner and cooking app. Direction: Circuit Fork. A confident upright dining fork whose three tines subtly become circuit traces ending in small round nodes. Extremely simple silhouette, thick balanced strokes, food recognized before technology. White background, flat near-black artwork, crisp vector-like edges, generous whitespace, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D or mockups. Square presentation. Center the main symbol above the wordmark "ForkLogic" in well-spaced contemporary typography, except for the integrated-wordmark direction where the wordmark is the main subject. Exact brand spelling: ForkLogic. Place a small understated concept label "01 / Circuit Fork" along the bottom. Strong professional design, usable silhouette, subtle tech cues, no chef hats, no leaves, no extra slogans.
